name: editQualificationType
description: Edits an EIM Qualification Type record by searching with a qualification type code or name, opening the matched row, switching to Edit mode, and saving the updated Qualification Type name. Supports partial name search; returns all matches if multiple.

basic.name: editQualificationType
basic.description: Edits an EIM Qualification Type record by searching with a qualification type code or name, opening the matched row, switching to Edit mode, and saving the updated Qualification Type name. Supports partial name search; returns all matches if multiple.

args.name: qualificationTypeCode
args.description: Qualification Type code to identify the record (e.g., 000002). If provided, search will be performed by code and the exact matching row will be opened.

args.name: qualificationTypeName
args.description: Qualification Type name to identify the record (supports partial match, case-insensitive). If multiple records match, the transformer returns the matching list and does not edit.

args.name: newQualificationTypeName
args.description: New Qualification Type name to save in the record. Required when a single record is matched and you want to update it.
